Game Overview

In 3D Touch, the core idea is straightforward: dive into a mesmerizing puzzle adventure with 3D Touch, where each tap crafts your path. With no turning back, carefully plot your moves across 100 levels. Strategize your way through escalating challenges, collect coins, and personalize your experience by unlocking unique cube skins. Engage in pure logic and foresight.
